name: Top 100 Netflix films with IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes scores
description: The 100 films with the most hours viewed in Netflix's published Top 10 data, each with its IMDb rating (0-10) and Rotten Tomatoes Tomatometer (0-100%) as returned by the OMDb API. Gap = RT% minus IMDb x10; positive means critics rated it higher.
license: Scores belong to IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes via OMDb; popularity data from Netflix
selectionRule: Films are ranked by the hours viewed that Netflix publishes: the larger of the total weekly hours across every week of Netflix's global weekly Top 10 (weeks 2021-07-04 to 2026-10-04) and the hours in the first 91 days from Netflix's Most Popular list. Films are taken in that order until 100 pass four checks against OMDb: the title is a movie, its runtime is within 12 minutes of the runtime Netflix lists (where Netflix lists one), IMDb has a rating from at least 5,000 votes, and a Rotten Tomatoes Tomatometer score is present. Films that fail a check are skipped and listed as popular but not scored. No score is ever estimated.
